name: FISCHERSCOPE GOLDSCOPE SD 300
description: The FISCHERSCOPE GOLDSCOPE SD 300 is a compact bench-top XRF spectrometer designed for fast, accurate, and non-destructive analysis of jewelry, coins, and precious metals. Equipped with a modern Silicon Drift Detector (SDD), it offers high precision, calibration-free analysis, and user-friendly operation with integrated computer, display, and FISIQ X software. Ideal for jewelry retailers, banks, pawn shops, and gold trading businesses.
short_desc: Compact XRF gold testing machine for fast, accurate, and non-destructive precious metal analysis.

name: GOLDSCOPE SD® 520
description: The GOLDSCOPE SD® 520 is an advanced XRF gold testing machine that accurately detects precious metals and elements such as Iridium and Ruthenium through non-destructive analysis. Designed for professional use, it delivers fast, precise, and reliable results for quality verification.

name: FISCHERSCOPE GOLDSCOPE SD 530
description: The FISCHERSCOPE GOLDSCOPE SD 530 is a high-performance XRF spectrometer designed for fast, precise, and non-destructive analysis of gold, silver, and other precious metals. Equipped with a Peltier-cooled Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) and advanced DPP+ technology, it delivers excellent accuracy, high detection sensitivity, and repeatability. With interchangeable measurement apertures and the ability to analyze up to 24 elements simultaneously, it is ideal for hallmarking centers, gold refineries, testing laboratories, and assaying centers.
short_desc: High-performance XRF gold testing machine with advanced DPP+ technology for precise precious metal analysis.

name: 1 Kg Automatic Gold Refining Machine
description: The 1 Kg Automatic Gold Refining Machine is designed for efficient and precise gold purification using advanced electrolytic processing technology. With a processing capacity of 1 kg per batch, this fully automatic machine minimizes manual effort while ensuring consistent refining results, reduced processing time, and safer operation. Featuring a durable metal body and installation support, it is suitable for professional gold refining applications.
short_desc: 1 Kg automatic electrolytic gold refining machine designed for precise purification and efficient operation.

name: 5 Kg Automatic Gold Refining Machine
description: The 5 Kg Automatic Gold Refining Machine is designed for efficient and precise gold purification, recycling, and refining of various types of gold scrap and waste, including old jewellery, sweeping dust, and polishing waste. It offers up to 99.99% purity and 100% material recovery with an advanced vacuum-based filtration system, automatic acid filling, triple-cycling condenser, and anticorrosive PPH construction. Its pollution-control system ensures odour-free and smoke-free operation, making it suitable for jewellery showrooms, shops, and professional refining facilities.
short_desc: 5 Kg automatic gold refining machine with up to 99.99% purity, vacuum filtration, and advanced pollution-control technology.

name: 20 Kg Automatic Gold Refining Machine
description: The 20 Kg Automatic Gold Refining Machine is designed for efficient and precise gold purification with a 20 kg processing capacity. Using advanced electrolytic processing technology, this fully automatic system simplifies the refining process while minimizing manual effort. Built with a durable polypropylene body and titanium components, it delivers up to 99.99% gold purity. It features a 1 HP motor, electric power supply, and reliable automatic operation, making it suitable for professional gold refining facilities.
short_desc: 20 Kg automatic electrolytic gold refining machine delivering up to 99.99% purity with efficient and reliable operation.

name: SISMA F2/N
description: The SISMA F2/N is a high-speed automatic machine for producing Grand Mother (Nonna) chain from 0.30 to 0.80 mm wire. With a suitable block it can also produce Figaro chain. It has a touch-screen panel for programming, a chain density sensor, an electronic speed regulator, two wire tensioners, a dust cover and an LED lamp. Average speed is 70 rings/min for Nonna and 200 rpm for Figaro (F2 mode), with automatic lubrication. Power: 0.45 kW, 230 V, single phase. Weight: 300 kg.
short_desc: High-speed machine for Grand Mother chain, 0.30-0.80 mm wire.

name: SISMA F3
description: The SISMA F3 is a high-speed automatic machine for medium-size curb Figaro chain, both right and left, from 0.60 to 2.20 mm wire. It includes an electronic chain collecting plate and can also make Figaro cable chain. The long and short link sequence is programmed with an electronic selector, and front-panel regulators allow quick wire size changes. Maximum speed is 150 rings/min with automatic lubrication. Power: 0.45 kW, 230 V, single phase. Weight: 470 kg. A laser version is available.
short_desc: High-speed machine for medium-size Figaro chain, 0.60-2.20 mm wire.

name: SISMA F2C/L
description: The SISMA F2C/L is a high-speed automatic laser machine for three-colour Figaro chain, single and double curb chain, and single and double cable chain, using 0.25 to 0.80 mm wire. Colour order and long/short link sequence are programmed on a touch screen. Chains can be hammered and diamond cut without re-welding, keeping the original alloy colours. It includes forced lubrication, a chain density sensor, three electronic wire tension devices, a laser insulation cover with fume extraction and a microscope support. Maximum speed is 270 rings/min. Weight: 300 kg.
short_desc: High-speed three-colour laser machine for Figaro, single and double curb chain.

name: SISMA F2/U
description: The SISMA F2/U is a universal machine for left and right curb Figaro chain from 0.25 to 0.80 mm and cable chain from 0.25 to 0.60 mm, without a chain collecting plate. The sequence of long and short, left and right links and cable is programmed on a touch screen, and it has a link threading function for cable chain. It includes a chain density sensor, two electronic wire stretchers and an LED lamp. Maximum speed is 270 rings/min. Available as F2/UL (laser-ready) and F2/UV (hollow chain). Weight: 300 kg.
short_desc: Universal machine for left/right Figaro chain and cable chain.

name: SISMA F2
description: The SISMA F2 is a high-speed compact automatic machine (CE version) for curb Figaro chain from 0.20 to 0.80 mm wire, with an electronic chain collecting plate and cam. It also suits Figaro cable chain. The long and short link sequence is set with an electronic selector, and hollow wire can be used with a special kit without losing performance. It includes a chain density sensor, an electronic speed regulator, two electronic wire stretchers, a dust cover and a low voltage lamp. Maximum speed is 270 rings/min. Available as F2L (laser) and F2V (hollow chain). Weight: 300 kg.
short_desc: High-speed compact machine for Figaro chain, 0.20-0.80 mm wire.

name: SISMA SFF
description: The SISMA SFF is a high-speed automatic machine for cable chain, with a wide range of wire sizes and particularly suited to very small chains. Its fast cycle and practical adjustment system allow quick tool changes. It comes with a motorised base, an electronic speed regulator and an LED lamp. Minimum wire size is 0.13 x 0.50 mm, speed is up to 650 links/min, and lubrication is automatic. Power: 0.35 kW, 230 V, single phase. Weight: 190 kg. Optional electronic wire tensioner and microscope support.
short_desc: High-speed machine for small cable chains, up to 650 links/min.

name: SISMA FZF/BL
description: The SISMA FZF/BL is an automatic machine preset for laser welding of Belcher chain made from flat wire. The chain design is easy to produce and very light. For a better diamond cut, rings can be coupled (married) so the cut faces stay in their original position. Workable wire runs from 0.80 x 0.08 mm to 2.5 x 0.25 mm. Maximum speed is 120 links/min with automatic lubrication. Power: 0.3 kW, 230 V, single phase, with 5/6 bar compressed air. Weight: 75 kg. Options include a focusing head support for married rings, an automatic chain skein winder and a microscope support kit.
short_desc: Laser-welded Belcher chain machine for flat wire.

name: SISMA FZF
description: The SISMA FZF is an automatic machine for cable and Belcher chains. It comes with a motorised base, an electronic speed regulator, a patented rotating head centering device and an LED lamp. Wire sizes are 0.30 to 1.20 mm for cable chain and 0.35 x 0.145 mm to 2.40 x 1.00 mm for Belcher chain. Production speed is 250 rings/min with automatic lubrication. Power: 0.35 kW, 230 V, single phase. Weight: 170 kg. Options include an electronic wire tensioner, a wire flexing device, a bobbin holder for double link cable chain and a microscope support.
short_desc: Automatic machine for cable and Belcher chains, 250 rings/min.

name: SISMA FZC/BL
description: The SISMA FZC/BL is an automatic machine preset for laser welding of Double cable Belcher chain made from flat wire. The chain design is easy to produce and very light. It handles flat wire from 0.15 x 1.00 mm to 0.31 x 2.30 mm, with ring outer diameters of 3.10 to 6.50 mm. Maximum speed is 90 rings/min. Power: 0.35 kW, 230 V, single phase. Weight: 180 kg. A microscope support is optional.
short_desc: Laser-welded Double cable Belcher chain machine for flat wire.

name: SISMA FZA
description: The SISMA FZA is a high-speed automatic machine for single links. It comes with a motorised base, an electronic speed regulator and an LED lamp. It works with wire from 0.30 to 1.20 mm at 250 rings/min, with automatic lubrication. Power: 350 VA, 220 V, single phase. Weight: 170 kg. Options include an electronic wire tensioner, a wire flexing device and a microscope support.
short_desc: High-speed automatic machine for single links, 250 rings/min.

name: SISMA F/TP
description: The SISMA F/TP is a high-speed automatic machine for side-cut cable chain and standard cable chain. Side-cut chain suits multi-row Bismark machines, avoiding the powder welding needed with traditional machines and giving more uniform chain pitch, a shorter production cycle and better karat assurance. It includes a motorised base, an electronic speed regulator, a patented rotating head centering device, a synchronised air blower and an LED lamp. Wire size is 0.30 to 1.50 mm and speed is 300 links/min, with automatic lubrication. Power: 0.3 kW, 230 V, single phase. Weight: 170 kg. Options include an electronic wire tensioner, a wire flexing device and a microscope support.
short_desc: High-speed machine for side-cut and standard cable chains, 300 links/min.
